How to Become a UGC Creator in 2026 (No Followers Needed)

A UGC creator makes short photos and videos for brands to use on their own ads, product pages and social accounts. Unlike an influencer, you are not selling access to your audience. You are selling content. That is why you can start with zero followers, a phone and a weekend.

This is the step-by-step path we see work for new creators in the US, Canada and Europe: pick a niche, film samples, publish a portfolio, set rates, then find and pitch brands. Want it all on one page with pitch templates and a rate card? Get the free UGC Starter Guide.

1. What a UGC Creator Actually Does

UGC creatorInfluencer
SellsContent the brand owns or licensesAccess to an audience
Followers neededNoneUsually thousands
Where it is postedBrand ads, product pages, brand accountsThe influencer's own account
How brands judge youSample videosReach and engagement

Many creators do both. For the full comparison read UGC vs influencer marketing.

2. The 7 Steps to Start

  1. Pick one or two niches you can film well.
  2. Film 6 to 8 sample videos with products you already own.
  3. Publish them on a free UGC portfolio with one link.
  4. Set starting rates and a gifted policy.
  5. Find brands and UGC jobs that hire beginners.
  6. Pitch a few brands every weekday and follow up once.
  7. Deliver early, ask for results, and turn clients into repeat work.

Step 1: Pick a Niche

Brands search for creators by category. Choose a niche where you already use the products and can film them in a believable setting: skincare in your bathroom, cleaning products in your kitchen, supplements in your morning routine. Beauty, fashion, home and fitness are the most common niches among creators approved on Newcollab, so competition there is higher; less crowded niches such as pets, food and tech can help you stand out faster.

Step 2: Film 6 to 8 Samples

No brand has hired you yet, so film spec samples: real UGC for products you own, made exactly as you would for a client. Cover a few formats: a talking-head testimonial, a problem/solution, an unboxing and a close-up demo. Need ideas? Use the 50 UGC product ideas list, and follow the hooks and scripts in how to make UGC videos brands pay for.

Quality Bar for Samples

Vertical 9:16, 15 to 30 seconds, captions on, clear audio, no watermark, and a hook in the first 3 seconds. Three clips at this bar beat twenty rough ones.

Step 3: Publish a Portfolio

Brands open a portfolio link before they read your pitch. Put your samples, niches, platforms and starting rates on one page. The free Newcollab UGC portfolio builder does this without an account. See real UGC portfolio examples from creators approved this month, and the full walkthrough in how to build a UGC portfolio.

Publish Your Portfolio Today

Free, no account, no follower minimum. Paste the link in your bio and in every pitch.

Build My Free UGC Portfolio

Step 4: Set Starting Rates

Beginners usually start between $50 and $150 per video for organic use and charge extra for paid ad usage, raw footage and extra hooks. Decide your gifted policy too: product-only collabs are fine for your first few portfolio pieces, never for ad usage. Full rate card in the UGC rates guide.

Steps 5-7: Find Work, Pitch and Deliver

  • Find work: UGC platforms, job boards and direct pitching. We compare the main options in the best UGC platforms for creators and list beginner-friendly sources in UGC jobs for beginners.
  • Pitch: a short email with one product idea and your portfolio link beats a long introduction. Start with brands that pay for UGC and brands that work with creators with no followers.
  • Deliver: captioned and clean versions, hook variations as separate files, on time. Agree usage and revisions in writing first: see UGC contracts and usage rights.

Your First 30 Days

WeekGoal
1Pick a niche, film 4 samples, publish your portfolio
2Film 4 more samples, set rates, list 30 target brands
3Pitch 3 to 5 brands every weekday, apply to UGC jobs
4Follow up once, deliver any gifted briefs, add them to your portfolio

Start With Your Portfolio

Every step after this one is easier with a portfolio link brands can open.

Publish My Free UGC Portfolio

Free. No account needed. No follower minimum.

FAQ

Do you need followers to become a UGC creator?

No. Brands buy UGC to post on their own ads and pages, so they hire on the quality of your samples, not your audience. Several UGC platforms state they have no follower minimum.

How long does it take to get your first UGC job?

It depends on how many brands you pitch and how strong your samples are. Creators who publish 6 to 8 clean samples and pitch a few brands every weekday usually land a first gifted or paid brief within a few weeks.

Can you become a UGC creator with just a phone?

Yes. A recent phone, window light and a quiet room are enough to start. The first upgrade worth buying is a clip-on microphone.

Is UGC a real way to make money?

Yes, but it is freelance work. Across 81 paid US UGC gigs listed on Newcollab in September and October 2026, the median posted pay was $150. Income grows with repeat clients and usage fees, not one-off videos.

Can I be a UGC creator outside the US?

Yes. Brands in Canada, the UK and the EU hire UGC creators, and several platforms accept creators from those countries. Quote in the brand's currency.
